pairs.target: dìèrrì xiàwǔ , nài lěi lái xuégōng zhǎo tǎ wéi , xiān wèn tā de xīgài néng bunéng zǒu yìxiǎo duàn píng lù , shuō zìjǐ yào dào xià jiē qǔ dōngxī , búbì gēn qù cái suàn péi tā .

pairs.english: Tavi tried a few steps at the courtyard gate without pain, still avoiding the stair shortcut; both descended along the gentle slope, reached the shop entrance, and then rested on the bench.

pairs.hanzi: 铺里没有摆兵器，墙上挂着雨罩和旧灯，一名短发女人正把几截芦管排到桌上，最末一截裂了，单独放在布边。

pairs.english: Nerai called her Yao Ting; she looked up, first checking Nerai's left hand, and asked should she carry it for her; Nerai said her right hand was still there and reached for that old empty wooden case by the wall.

pairs.english: Beside Yao Ting was also a small case containing a thin darkened piece of wood, with holes along its edge where fine cord had passed; before Tavi could see clearly, two children first squeezed in at the door.
pairs.hanzi: 姚汀身旁另有一只小匣，里面是一片发黑的薄木，边上留着细绳穿过的孔，塔维还没看清，门口先挤进来两个孩子。

pairs.english: One asked if an Outrider had brought it back; Yao Ting said yes, but do not touch yet; the child instead asked whether the black edge had burned out there; she said soaked in water, not burned.

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào zhe wǎng pángbiān ràng le yìdiǎn , yáo tīng jiāng mùpiàn gē wěn , wèn tǎ wéi shìbushì yě yào wèn shāo guò méiyǒu , tā máng shuō zìjǐ xiǎng wèn zhè shì shénme mùtou .
pairs.english: Nerai smiled and moved a little aside; Yao Ting set the wood piece securely and asked whether Tavi too wanted to know if it had burned; he hastily said he wanted to ask what kind of wood this was.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑着往旁边让了一点，姚汀将木片搁稳，问塔维是不是也要问烧过没有，他忙说自己想问这是什么木头。

pairs.target: yáo tīng nálái yìwǎn qīngshuǐ , jiāng mùpiàn héngfàng jìnqù , shéng kǒng lǐ sāi zhe de yìtuán qiǎnsè xì xiè mànmàn chīshuǐ , mùpiàn què réng fú zhe , hēi biān zhǐ tiēzhù wǎn yán .
pairs.english: Yao Ting brought a bowl of clean water and laid flat the wood in it; a pale clump of fine debris stuffed in the cord hole slowly soaked up water, yet the piece still floated, its black edge only touching the bowl rim.
pairs.hanzi: 姚汀拿来一碗清水，将木片横放进去，绳孔里塞着的一团浅色细屑慢慢吃水，木片却仍浮着，黑边只贴住碗沿。

pairs.target: zhè shì dī dì dù shuǐ shí jiǎnhuí de fúbiāo mù , yuánlái de shéng yǐjīng duàn le , yáo tīng zhǐ zǒu dào nà chù wān kǒu , méi shuō zìjǐ zhīdào tā cóng nǎyìtiáo hé piāolái .
pairs.english: This was buoy wood picked up while crossing water in the lowlands; its original cord had already snapped; Yao Ting had only reached that bay mouth and did not claim to know which river it had drifted from.
pairs.hanzi: 这是低地渡水时捡回的浮标木，原来的绳已经断了，姚汀只走到那处湾口，没说自己知道它从哪一条河漂来。

pairs.target: háizi wèn wān kǒu wàitou yǒuméiyǒu chéng , tā shuō yǒurén zài liǎngàn huànhuò , búshì zhǐyǒu shānshàng cái chīfàn , kě zìjǐ méi guò nà dào yuǎn dī , bié jiào tā ná méi jiàn guò de láijiǎng .
pairs.english: The child asked whether there were cities beyond the bay mouth; she said people traded goods on both banks, not only mountain people ate, but she had not crossed that distant embankment, so do not ask her to tell what she had not seen.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子问湾口外头有没有城，她说有人在两岸换货，不是只有山上才吃饭，可自己没过那道远堤，别叫她拿没见过的来讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu bǐ le bǐ mùpiàn de kuān , méi pèng tā , wèn dài huílái yào zuò shénme , yáo tīng shuō wèn zuò fúzǐ de gōngfáng yuànbuyuàn mǎi , lùshang hǎokàn zǒng bùnéng dǐ fànqián .
pairs.english: Tavi measured the wood's width with a gesture without touching it, asking what bringing it back was for; Yao Ting said to ask the float workshop whether it would buy it; pretty sights on the road could hardly pay for meals.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手比了比木片的宽，没碰它，问带回来要做什么，姚汀说问做浮子的工房愿不愿买，路上好看总不能抵饭钱。

pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾问那人有没有回信，她说还没，昨日叫人送去的样还在试，随后把木片翻过去，底面有一道磨圆的缺口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuányǐwéi shì chǐyìn , kànjiàn quēkǒu lǐkǎ zhe yípiàn suìshí , yòu bùgǎn rèn , yáo tīng shùnzhe tā de yǎnjīng kàn guòqù , shuō lāoqǐ shí biàn zhèyàng , zìjǐ méi jiàn shuí yǎo tā .
pairs.english: Tavi had thought it a tooth mark; seeing a stone fragment lodged in the notch, he doubted that; Yao Ting looked along his gaze, saying it was like that when retrieved and she had not seen anyone bite it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为是齿印，看见缺口里卡着一片碎石，又不敢认，姚汀顺着他的眼睛看过去，说捞起时便这样，自己没见谁咬它。

pairs.target: tā méi tì tā biān yìzhī shuǐ lǐ de dōngxī , yòngbù xī qù shuǐ , jiāng mùpiàn shōuhuí xiǎo xiá , dàobǎ nà jié liè lúguǎn tuī jìn , shuō zhè cái shì zìjǐ dài qù yòu dài huílái de .
pairs.english: She did not invent a water creature for him; using cloth to absorb the water, she returned the wood to the small case, and instead pushed that cracked reed closer, saying this was what she had taken out and brought back.
pairs.hanzi: 她没替他编一只水里的东西，用布吸去水，将木片收回小匣，倒把那截裂芦管推近，说这才是自己带去又带回来的。

pairs.english: Fine cord had been wound around the tube's mouth, its middle crack cinched pale by wet thread; Nerai turned it once in her right hand without bringing it to her lips, first asking whether it could still sound.

pairs.english: She told that part very briefly; Tavi instead looked outside the shop, the afternoon street perfectly clear; across it a vegetable deliverer reached up and lifted a curtain, even the patch on its corner visible.

pairs.target: tā wèn nàshí kào shénme zhǎo huílái , yáo tīng shuō méi zhǎo , ànbiān děngdào tiānliàng , dù shuǐ de qián zhàofù , dānwù de yíyè yě méi tuì gěi tāmen .

pairs.target: nài lěi dītóu kàn nà jié guǎn , guò le yíhuìer , shuō zìjǐ yǐqián xián liǎnggè rén zǒng chuī tóngyàng yì diào fán , yáo tīng shuō nà nǐ rújīn gāi jìde shuí chuī de nántīng le .

pairs.target: tā xiào chūlái , jiāng guǎnzǐ huán huíqù , zuǒshǒu liǎnggēn zhǐtou dā zài xiá yán , réng méiyǒu xiàng biéde zhǐtou nàyàng yìqí shōulǒng .
pairs.english: She laughed and returned the tube; two fingers of her left hand rested on the case edge, still not curling together like her other fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 她笑出来，将管子还回去，左手两根指头搭在匣沿，仍没有像别的指头那样一齐收拢。

pairs.english: Yao Ting asked whether she would go next time; Nerai said she would not answer yet, her hand had not passed this hurdle; if they meant to wait for her, find someone else instead, do not first book the date under her name.
pairs.hanzi: 姚汀问她下回去不去，奈蕾说先不答，手还没过这一关，若要等自己，便另找个人，别把日子先记在她名下。

pairs.english: Tavi sat beside them without saying for her that it was nearly healed; Yao Ting did not urge her either, only saying I'll keep your things: it is the case that waits, not this party.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在旁边，没替她说快好了，姚汀也没有劝，只说东西替你留着，等的是匣子，不是这一趟人。

pairs.english: Before leaving Nerai took that old empty wooden case; the buoy wood and cracked tube remained in the shop; Tavi asked what the case used to hold, and she said medicine and thread, but it could hold other things too.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，奈蕾拿走的是那只旧空木匣，浮标木和裂管仍留在铺里，塔维问匣子原先装什么，她说药和线，还能装别的。

pairs.english: He reached, wanting to carry it for her; she had him support the door curtain instead, tucking the case under her right arm herself; when both returned to the bench, she first asked whether he wanted to sit a little longer.

pairs.english: Tavi said yes; the case lid lay between them; he gazed at an old groove worn shallow in the wood and heard another child in the shop asking about the river over there.
